answer: Fresh-task bond: each identity locks a 70-credit bond and draws one task, issued each epoch as a pulse of key-bound tasks. It does the task and must forge a receipt on the terrace registry, where task k costs 40+6(k-1). Auditors re-run a sample; a reused or bought receipt burns the bond, since receipts are key-bound — the rented-task ring fails. 1,000 fakes cost 3,107,000 vs a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its full share.
